# AI Sales Advisory

> A voice AI product studio that designs, builds and launches dependable voice agents for sales and service teams, including white-label solutions.

AI Sales Advisory helps growing businesses turn customer conversations into action. Solutions are built around a defined operational outcome and can answer calls, qualify leads, book appointments, route requests, update business systems and support follow-up workflows.

## Solutions

- [Custom voice agents](https://aisalesadvisory.com/services.html#custom-agents): Purpose-built agents for reception, qualification, scheduling, triage and follow-up.
- [White-label voice AI](https://aisalesadvisory.com/services.html#white-label): Branded voice AI products for agencies, consultants and software companies.
- [AI sales workflows](https://aisalesadvisory.com/services.html#workflows): Connect conversations to CRM records, calendars, alerts, tasks and next-best actions.
- Voice AI strategy: Scope the use case, commercial case, integrations, risks and launch plan.

## Delivery approach

1. Find the value: define the job, economics, systems and risks.
2. Design the experience: map dialogue, tone, guardrails and human hand-offs.
3. Build and integrate: connect telephony, calendars, CRMs, messaging and relevant APIs.
4. Launch and improve: test realistic scenarios, monitor performance and iterate.

## About

Founder Bhaskar brings more than 10 years of experience across sales strategy, GTM operations, pricing and product, including roles at LinkedIn and Ding.com.
